desc: A must-have item for delinquent mode. Along with the nail bat, it is known as one of the two great weapons of delinquents. Its intimidating appearance is more effective than its practicality.

desc: Together with the wooden sword, it is considered one of the two great weapons of delinquents and is a must-have in delinquent mode. Its vicious shape is so intimidating that even the person using it sometimes gets scared.

desc: A very large frying pan. There is a rumor that it was originally made to cook ostrich eggs.

desc: A weapon rumored to become strongest in the evening. However, when you actually try using it, the rumor doesn’t seem very believable.

desc: Used for peeling apples and preparing sashimi. Some say it was made as a weapon for cooking monsters, but so far no monster dishes have ever appeared.

name: Magical Stomper

name: Hitōban Hammer

name: Trial Hammer
desc: It looks almost identical to the Juggernaut Hammer, but because it’s made from a lighter metal than the real one, even second-year students can handle it.

name: Assassin’s Thunder
desc: A weapon favored by assassins. Electricity flows through the entire blade except for the rubber part of the handle, and simply touching it can cause fatal damage.

name: Thunder Saber
desc: A beam sword with a blade that focuses energy flowing from the rechargeable battery in the handle. The sound it makes each time it’s swung is really cool.

name: Asura Blade

name: Unsigned Katana
desc: A traditional Japanese blade. Not one from the era when such swords were treated like works of art as symbols of the samurai, but a finely crafted, unsigned weapon used by nameless soldiers during the Warring States period. Through long use, the blade has been stained a deep crimson.

name: Deep Seaweed

desc: A pair of hard metal gloves. When struck against solid ground or a wall, they scatter sparks and become fists of flame.

name: Spirit of Righteousness

desc: An enhanced version of the Spirit of Righteousness whose output has exceeded its limits. Its light shines with the brilliance of a divine immortal, but it also places a heavy burden on the materials. Only fourth-year students or higher can equip it.

desc: It came to be called the Rainbow Fist because every time a technique is unleashed, it leaves behind a rainbow-colored trail. Since a rainbow appears whenever its special move is used, it’s often used during school festivals.

name: Rainbo Fist
desc: A fake version of the Rainbow Fist. It breaks easily with use, but because its power is weaker, even lower-year students can use it.

name: Maxima Gauntlet
desc: A very heavy pair of gloves, but if mastered, they can unleash tremendous power.

name: Gambler’s Hand
desc: A pair of gloves with an Ace of Spades engraved on the back of the hand. When its special move is used, playing cards appear.

name: Battle Claw
desc: A pair of gloves said to have been used mainly in large-scale battles in ancient times. They have since been modified for hunting monsters, but their overwhelming and intimidating presence remains unchanged.

name: Event Battle Claw

name: Axis of Heaven and Earth

name: Blade Hand

name: Biting Claws
desc: A pair of gloves designed to look like a monster with its mouth open. The sharp horns growing from the fingertips show just how powerful this weapon is.

name: Oni Bite Claws
desc: A pair of gloves transformed by the yokai known as an “Oni” in order to attack its user. If you keep fighting and satisfy the oni’s hunger, you can avoid being eaten. The phrase “oni hitokuchi” (an oni’s single bite) is used to describe the ferocity with which an oni devours something in one mouthful.

name: Gigantic Gauntlets
desc: The heaviest pair of gloves. This weapon is a modified version of gloves said to have been used by an ancient race of giants, adapted for student use. They are difficult to handle, but once you get used to them, there’s nothing left to fear.

name: Viper Gauntlets
desc: A pair of gloves made from snake skin, finished by coating the surface with snake venom. Anyone struck by them will inevitably fall into a severe state of poisoning, so their sale and use are now prohibited.

name: Viper Knuckles
desc: An unfinished version of the Viper Gauntlets. Because the venom coating is incomplete, even first-year students can use them.

name: Eagle Claw
desc: A pair of gloves modeled after the hooked talons of a hawk. They are designed more for tearing attacks than for blunt strikes.

name: Taurus Gauntlets
desc: A legendary pair of gloves said to be powerful enough to crush even mountains. Looking at their rugged and bold design, it almost feels like it might actually be possible.

name: Ultimate Gauntlets
desc: As the name suggests, the ultimate pair of gloves. It is said that the gloves themselves choose their wielder.

name: Phenomenal Gauntlets

name: Dual Gauntlets
desc: With an appearance like having large bowling balls fitted over the hands, they look overwhelmingly powerful at a glance.

name: Joe’s Bandages

desc: A weapon rumored to become strongest in the evening. However, when you actually try using it, the rumor doesn’t seem very believable.

name: Spiked Bat
desc: Together with the wooden sword, it is considered one of the two great weapons of delinquents and is a must-have in delinquent mode. Its vicious shape is so intimidating that even the person using it sometimes gets scared.

name: Limit Break Stinger
desc:
A modified Stinger of legend. Its latent power is forcibly drawn out, making it usable only by fourth-year students or higher.
It will be removed during the scheduled maintenance on Thursday, May 11, 2006.

name: Tonic Blade
desc:
A fake Sonic Blade. Said to have been used by a bold bartender to mix cocktails. Its output is weak, so even first-year students can use it.
It will be removed during the scheduled maintenance on Thursday, May 11, 2006.

name: Paper Driver
desc:
A screwdriver made of papercraft. Naturally weaker than the real thing. Keep a perfect safety record and it might turn gold?
It will be removed during the scheduled maintenance on Thursday, May 11, 2006.

name: Trial Hammer
desc:
Looks just like the Juggernaut Hammer, but it’s made from a lighter metal than the real one, so even second-year students can use it.
It will be removed during the scheduled maintenance on Thursday, May 11, 2006.

name: Pringer
desc:
A fake Bringer. Even third-year students can equip it, but its attack power is low. Surprisingly useful as a mixer when making sweets?
It will be removed during the scheduled maintenance on Thursday, May 11, 2006.

name: Event Megaton Hammer
desc: A somewhat compact hammer, but with more than enough power. Its structure concentrates mass at the point of impact at the moment of the strike, allowing it to be wielded with one hand while still delivering heavy damage.

name: 실전 목도 YT
desc:
불량 모드의 필수품. 못박힌 배트와 함께 2대 불량 무기라 불리운다. 일반 목도보다는 실전용이라 할 수 있다.
이것은 요구르팅 1주년 기념 선물이라고 한다.

name: 블러디 바로 소드 YT
desc:
거리를 재는데 탁월한 기능을 가지고 있는 블레이드. 주로 초급학년들에게 적당하다.
이것은 요구르팅 1주년 기념 선물이라고 한다.

name: Stinger
desc: Cutter-type blade

name: Screwdriver
desc: A Phillips screwdriver shaped like a screw.

name: Thunder Saber
desc: A beam sword with a blade that focuses energy flowing from the rechargeable battery in the handle. The sound it makes each time it’s swung is really cool.

name: Red Sandalwood Bokken
desc: A wooden sword made from red sandalwood, a material long said to be legendary. It has a presence and dignity unlike an ordinary wooden sword, making it a must-have if you want to call yourself a true boss!

name: Baro Sword M
desc: The Baro Sword boasts a level of precision that even professionals approve of as a measuring tool. Its length is said to exactly match the distance that light travels in a vacuum in 1/299,792,458 of a second.

name: Rose Rapier
desc: A blade with a long, pointed sword edge. Like a rose with sharp thorns, its blade is beautifully stained a deep crimson.

name: Foreman Sonic Blade
desc: A cutting machine that enjoys tremendous support from workers at lumberyards and construction sites. As a weapon, it boasts power comparable to a standard Sonic Blade.

name: Unsigned Katana
desc: A traditional Japanese blade. Not one from the era when such swords were treated like works of art as symbols of the samurai, but a finely crafted, unsigned weapon used by nameless soldiers during the Warring States period. Through long use, the blade has been stained a deep crimson.

name: Gigantic Hammer
desc: A weapon created to duel against someone wielding the Juggernaut Hammer. From the day you take up this weapon, you are destined to fight the wielder of the Juggernaut Hammer.

name: Jinmenju Bokken
desc:
A wooden sword made from the yokai “Jinmenju.” It is cursed—those who keep using it are said to be transformed into a Jinmenju themselves. If that doesn’t bother you, enjoy its overwhelming cursed power.
(It will become non-tradeable on August 17, 2006, and will be removed on August 24.)

name: Vampire Rapier
desc:
A weapon said to have been used by an immortal vampire to bathe in the blood of maidens. Perhaps inhabited by its former owner’s soul, the vines wrapped around it writhe in search of prey.
(It will become non-tradeable on August 17, 2006, and will be removed on August 24.)

name: Raiju Stinger
desc:
A Dark Saber empowered by the lightning of the yokai “Raiju,” said to appear with thunderbolts. When using its skill, be sure to warn others about incoming lightning.
(It will become non-tradeable on August 17, 2006, and will be removed on August 24.)

name: Kamaitachi
desc:
A blade said to be a yokai “Kamaitachi” in disguise. It is said that the first knocks a person down, the second cuts them, and the third heals the wound.
(It will become non-tradeable on August 17, 2006, and will be removed on August 24.)

name: Hitōban Hammer
desc:
A weapon that has captured the yokai “Rokurokubi,” said to be human by day but whose head flies from its body at night. Be careful it doesn’t fly off when using its skill!
(It will become non-tradeable on August 17, 2006, and will be removed on August 24.)

name: Wooden Sword
desc: A must-have item for delinquent mode. Along with the nail bat, it is known as one of the two great weapons of delinquents. Its intimidating appearance is more effective than its practicality.

name: Red Sandalwood Bokken
desc: A wooden sword made from red sandalwood, a material long said to be legendary. It has a presence and dignity unlike an ordinary wooden sword, making it a must-have if you want to call yourself a true boss!

name: Baro Sword
desc: A blade equipped with a handy measuring function. Perfect for first-year students.

name: Baro Sword M
desc: The Baro Sword boasts a level of precision that even professionals approve of as a measuring tool. Its length is said to exactly match the distance that light travels in a vacuum in 1/299,792,458 of a second.

name: Stinger
desc: Cutter-type blade

name: Anna Stinger
desc: A cute pink Stinger decorated with an illustration of SD Anna. With Anna by your side anytime, anywhere!

name: Vine Rapier
desc: A blade with a long, pointed sword edge. Vines are wrapped around the blade and the guard.

name: Rose Rapier
desc: A blade with a long, pointed sword edge. Like a rose with sharp thorns, its blade is beautifully stained a deep crimson.

name: Sonic Blade
desc: A blade equipped with a rapidly spinning edge that operates on the same principle as a chainsaw.

name: Foreman Sonic Blade
desc: A cutting machine that enjoys tremendous support from workers at lumberyards and construction sites. As a weapon, it boasts power comparable to a standard Sonic Blade.

name: Screwdriver
desc: A Phillips screwdriver shaped like a screw.

name: Phillips Screwdriver
desc: A screwdriver whose cross-shaped tip is made from a special alloy. It is designed so that even screws with stripped heads can still be tightened or loosened.

name: Katana
desc: A traditional Japanese blade, symbol of the samurai. Its sharp edge makes it restricted for use by lower-year students.

name: Unsigned Katana
desc: A traditional Japanese blade. Not one from the era when such swords were treated like works of art as symbols of the samurai, but a finely crafted, unsigned weapon used by nameless soldiers during the Warring States period. Through long use, the blade has been stained a deep crimson.

name: Juggernaut Hammer
desc: A crude, brutally heavy hammer. It looks so intimidating that you feel like you might take damage just by looking at it. You should absolutely avoid dueling someone wielding this weapon.

name: Gigantic Hammer
desc: A weapon created to duel against someone wielding the Juggernaut Hammer. From the day you take up this weapon, you are destined to fight the wielder of the Juggernaut Hammer.

name: Thunder Saber
desc: A beam sword with a blade that focuses energy flowing from the rechargeable battery in the handle. The sound it makes each time it’s swung is really cool.

name: Dark Saber
desc: It is said that when the wielder of the Thunder Saber chooses the path of evil with a strong will, the blade becomes stained with darkness and transforms into the Dark Saber. However, there are also rumors that replacing the battery will turn it back into a normal Thunder Saber.

name: Bringer
desc: A blade shaped like a large scythe.

name: Punisher
desc: A weapon that became the prototype for the Bringer. Originally, it was not used for hunting monsters, but rather for executing criminals.

name: Seaweed
desc: A blade made from golden powder said to be used by sea fairies.

name: Deep Seaweed
desc: A blade said to have been made by a fairy who lives at the bottom of the deep sea. Its blade shines with a brilliant blue glow, but the fairy who made it lives on the dark ocean floor where no light reaches, and will never know how it looks.

name: Megaton Hammer
desc: A somewhat compact hammer, but with more than enough power. Its structure concentrates mass at the point of impact at the moment of the strike, allowing it to be wielded with one hand while still delivering heavy damage.

name: Fly Pang☆
desc: A very large frying pan. There is a rumor that it was originally made to cook ostrich eggs.

name: Magical Stomper
desc: It looks like a toy, but it actually boasts considerable power. An opponent who gets hit while letting their guard down will be surprised by the damage!

name: Light Breaker
desc: A blade made using a fluorescent light tube as its base. It has been reinforced so that it won’t break easily, allowing you to fight without worry.

name: Vermilion Edge
desc: This blade features a large red diamond set in the guard, even bigger than the blade itself. It is said to grow stronger when the gem emits light.

name: Stinger FE
desc: The final evolution of the Stinger.

name: Vice-Principal Slayer
desc: A legendary blade that has been secretly passed down only among sixth-year students. It is said that whoever wields this blade gains the power to defeat even the vice-principal.

name: Green Bamboo Claws
desc: A pair of gloves that have the look and feel of green bamboo.

name: Gigantic Gauntlets
desc: The heaviest pair of gloves. This weapon is a modified version of gloves said to have been used by an ancient race of giants, adapted for student use. They are difficult to handle, but once you get used to them, there’s nothing left to fear.

name: Dual Gauntlets
desc: With an appearance like having large bowling balls fitted over the hands, they look overwhelmingly powerful at a glance.

name: Ultimate Spirit of Righteousness
desc:
A weapon whose Haoran energy output has exceeded its limits. Its light shines like that of an immortal, but it places great strain on its materials. Only fourth-year students or higher can equip it.
It will be removed during the scheduled maintenance on Thursday, May 11, 2006.

name: Viper Knuckles
desc:
An unfinished Viper Knuckle. The poison coating is incomplete, so even first-year students can use it.
It will be removed during the scheduled maintenance on Thursday, May 11, 2006.

name: Training Bandages
desc:
Bandages under 2.5 meters long. Protect your fists well and focus on your training. Can be used by first-year students.
It will be removed during the scheduled maintenance on Thursday, May 11, 2006.

name: Rainbo Fist
desc:
A fake Rainbow Fist. It breaks easily with use, but its low power makes it usable even by lower-year students.
It will be removed during the scheduled maintenance on Thursday, May 11, 2006.

name: Phantom Cutter
desc:
A fake left behind at the scene by a phantom thief who appears out of nowhere and steals rare items, swapping it with the real one. Can be equipped by third-year students.
It will be removed during the scheduled maintenance on Thursday, May 11, 2006.

name: Event Battle Claw
desc: A pair of gloves said to have been used mainly in large-scale battles in ancient times. They have since been modified for hunting monsters, but their overwhelming and intimidating presence remains unchanged.

name: 무비유환 글로브 YT
desc:
단단한 금속 재질의 글로브.
이것은 요구르팅 1주년 기념 선물이라고 한다.

name: The 자린고비 피스트 YT
desc:
빼빼 마른 글로브.
이것은 요구르팅 1주년 기념 선물이라고 한다.

name: Spirit of Righteousness
desc: Gloves with lenses on the back that glow blue. They allow you to unleash skill attacks that fire radiant energy projectiles.

name: Joe’s Bandages
desc: A set of bandages said to have been wrapped around the fists of Joe, the legendary king of martial artists.

name: Phoenix Knuckles
desc: A pair of gloves said to be made from the feathers of a phoenix.

name: Forewarned is Forearmed
desc: A pair of hard metal gloves. When struck against solid ground or a wall, they scatter sparks and become fists of flame.

name: Ultimate Zaringobi Fist
desc: A pair of gloves said to drive their wearer into desperate situations. Whether you survive and seize victory or collapse from exhaustion, it truly becomes a do-or-die battle. Perfect for training the spirit.

name: Blackjack
desc: These gloves are said to draw either the best possible card or the worst possible card—each with a 50% chance—when it comes down to the decisive moment. Because of this, they are both admired and feared by many gamblers.

name: Venom Knuckles
desc: Gloves made from snakeskin, finished with a special blend of snake venom applied to the surface. Anyone struck by them will inevitably suffer severe poisoning, so their sale and use are now prohibited. Prolonged use may cause the poison to affect the wearer as well…

name: Phenometer Proto
desc: A prototype of the Phenometer Gear developed for exploration. It has functions not found in the mass-produced Phenometer Gear, but its combat performance has already been fully perfected.

name: Violet Fist
desc: An improved version of the Rainbow Fist. The violet color in the rainbow trail that appears whenever a technique is unleashed is said to shine even more beautifully now. For some reason, its users often seem to be quite well-tanned.

name: Great Toad Gloves
desc:
Gloves made from the skin of the yokai “Oogama,” said to emit an aura that lures in people and animals as prey. Sticky to the touch and constantly giving off a tempting aura, making them quite troublesome.
(It will become non-tradeable on August 17, 2006, and will be removed on August 24.)

name: Ittan-Momen Bandages
desc:
A type of tsukumogami, “Ittan Momen,” a cloth yokai that has taken the form of bandages. One tan is about 11 meters, making it longer than standard bandages and suited for advanced students.
(It will become non-tradeable on August 17, 2006, and will be removed on August 24.)

name: Yatagarasu
desc:
Gloves made using the wings of the yokai “Yatagarasu,” a three-legged crow said to be a divine messenger. They flap to point the correct path, making them perfect even for those with a poor sense of direction.
(It will become non-tradeable on August 17, 2006, and will be removed on August 24.)

name: One Hundred Yokai Scenes
desc:
Gloves imbued with a mysterious aura after being painted by a yokai artist. Stare at them long enough and you’ll see 100 yokai emerge in 3D. Be sure to take a 15-minute break every hour?
(It will become non-tradeable on August 17, 2006, and will be removed on August 24.)

name: Oni Bite Claws
desc:
Gloves said to be a yokai “Oni” in disguise, waiting to attack its wearer. Keep fighting to satisfy its hunger, or you may be devoured. The phrase “oni hitokuchi” refers to the way an oni devours things in a single bite.
(It will become non-tradeable on August 17, 2006, and will be removed on August 24.)

name: Forewarned is Forearmed
desc: A pair of hard metal gloves. When struck against solid ground or a wall, they scatter sparks and become fists of flame.

name: Unwarned is Unarmed
desc: The original version of “Be Prepared,” a bestselling beginner glove. Ironically, it was released with defects due to negligence and later recalled. As a result, it came to be mockingly called “Unprepared, Trouble Follows.”

name: The Ringo Fist
desc: A pair of gloves covered in patches from being repaired many times. They embody a hungry, never-give-up spirit.

name: Ultimate Zaringobi Fist
desc: A pair of gloves said to drive their wearer into desperate situations. Whether you survive and seize victory or collapse from exhaustion, it truly becomes a do-or-die battle. Perfect for training the spirit.

name: Spirit of Righteousness
desc: Gloves with lenses on the back that glow blue. They allow you to unleash skill attacks that fire radiant energy projectiles.

name: Righteous Heart
desc: A pair of gloves whose gauntlet lenses glow with a blue light. It is said that only those whose hearts have nothing to be ashamed of before heaven and earth can unleash their true power.

name: Gambler’s Hand
desc: Gloves engraved with the Ace of Spades on the back of the hand. Cards appear when using skill attacks.

name: Blackjack
desc: These gloves are said to draw either the best possible card or the worst possible card—each with a 50% chance—when it comes down to the decisive moment. Because of this, they are both admired and feared by many gamblers.

name: Viper Gauntlets
desc: Gloves made from snakeskin, finished with a coating of snake venom on the surface. Anyone struck by them will inevitably suffer severe poisoning, so their sale and use are now prohibited. They are secretly used as a weapon by delinquent students.

name: Venom Knuckles
desc: Gloves made from snakeskin, finished with a special blend of snake venom applied to the surface. Anyone struck by them will inevitably suffer severe poisoning, so their sale and use are now prohibited. Prolonged use may cause the poison to affect the wearer as well…

name: Joe’s Bandages
desc: A set of bandages said to have been wrapped around the fists of Joe, the legendary king of martial artists.

name: Joe’s Blood & Tears Bandages
desc: A worn set of bandages said to have been wrapped around the fists of Joe, the legendary king of martial artists. They are soaked with Joe’s blood, sweat, and tears.

name: Phenomenal Gauntlets
desc: These gloves, equipped with a gauge panel on the back of the hand, were created for exploration purposes.

name: Phenometer Proto
desc: A prototype of the Phenometer Gear developed for exploration. It has functions not found in the mass-produced Phenometer Gear, but its combat performance has already been fully perfected.

name: Rainbow Fist
desc: It came to be called the Rainbow Fist because it leaves a rainbow trail each time a technique is unleashed. A rainbow appears with every skill attack, making it popular during school festivals.

name: Violet Fist
desc: An improved version of the Rainbow Fist. The violet color in the rainbow trail that appears whenever a technique is unleashed is said to shine even more beautifully now. For some reason, its users often seem to be quite well-tanned.

name: Phoenix Knuckles
desc: A pair of gloves said to be made from the feathers of a phoenix.

name: Heavenly Phoenix
desc: A pair of gloves said to be made from the feathers left behind by a phoenix that repeated death and rebirth a thousand times before finally ascending to the heavens.

name: Gordian Cutter
desc: The fastest weapon available. However, because it focuses so much on speed, its power is not very high.

name: Supernatural Might
desc: It is spoken of alongside the saying, “Technique is Kaitō Ranma, strength is Kairiki Ranshin.” Though this weapon was created by an evil organization as an imitation of “Kaitō Ranma,” it is said that if wielded by someone with a pure, righteous, and strong heart, it will reveal its true power.

name: Axis of Heaven and Earth
desc: It’s hard to understand the mindset of anyone who would use gloves with such a bizarre design. However, every student who has used these gloves can’t stop praising them.

name: Innocent Radiance
desc: A pair of gloves with a design that surpasses art by a hair’s breadth. Once you get used to them, they’re said to be surprisingly cute. Rumor has it the design comes from drawings made on a whim by either a child or a chimpanzee.

name: Battle Claw
desc: A pair of gloves said to have been used mainly in large-scale battles in ancient times. They have since been modified for hunting monsters, but their overwhelming and intimidating presence remains unchanged.

name: Blade Hand
desc: This weapon is closer to a blade than a glove. When worn on both arms, it feels as if you’re fighting with two swords. It’s well suited for quick, rapid attacks.

name: Eagle Claw
desc: A pair of gloves modeled after the hooked talons of a hawk. They are designed more for tearing attacks than for blunt strikes.

name: Biting Claws
desc: A pair of gloves designed to look like a monster with its mouth open. The sharp horns growing from the fingertips show just how powerful this weapon is.

name: Riot Gauntlets
desc: Gauntlets that convert negative emotions like anger and sadness into strength. After battle, the wearer is said to feel strangely refreshed.

name: Maxima Gauntlet
desc: Very heavy gloves that slow down attack speed but deliver powerful blows.

name: Windscatter Slash
desc: Legendary gloves said to be powerful enough to shatter mountains. Their straightforward, sturdy design only adds to the rumor’s credibility.

name: Ultimate Gauntlets
desc: As the name suggests, the ultimate pair of gloves. It is said that the gloves themselves choose their wielder.

name: Trump Power
desc: It resembles a trumpet that is broken and tattered on all sides.

name: Scratch Mixer
desc: At first listen, it sends a chill down your spine, but if you keep listening, before you know it you’re completely hooked.

name: MC MacStar
desc: A mass-produced version of the Mura used by the legendary MC, MC MacStar. It lets people indulge in nostalgia for MC MacStar, and has been met with an explosive reaction from the public.

name: Zigzag Tap
desc: Because this single Mura can produce a wide variety of tones, it is favored by students who aspire to avant-garde art.

name: Magnedio
desc: When surrounded by students wearing this Mura, with antennas sprouting from all over it, you start to feel as if you’ve wandered onto another planet. Just like its unusual shape, the way it’s used is equally unique.

name: Metal Baroque
desc: A Mura designed for combat rather than for dancing or music. Anyone who sees this gleaming metallic Mura can’t help but feel a sense of fear.

name: Bass Clarinet
desc:
A clarinet that excels in low tones. Only fourth-year students or higher can equip it.
It will be removed during the scheduled maintenance on Thursday, May 11, 2006.

name: German Bongo
desc:
An obvious fake of the Shaman Bongo, but since even first-year students can equip it, it’s surprisingly useful for a knockoff.
It will be removed during the scheduled maintenance on Thursday, May 11, 2006.

name: The DJ βedit
desc:
A beginner afro wig developed so lower-year students can use it. Equipped not only with turntables, but also a state-of-the-art 4-channel mixer. Usable by first-year students.
It will be removed during the scheduled maintenance on Thursday, May 11, 2006.

name: Flahhi
desc:
A worn-out Fluffy that sounds like it’s lost all its air no matter how you play it. Adjusted so it can be equipped by second-year students or higher.
It will be removed during the scheduled maintenance on Thursday, May 11, 2006.

name: Trial Scarf
desc:
A sample version of the Tam-Tam Muffler. Can be equipped by third-year students or higher.
It will be removed during the scheduled maintenance on Thursday, May 11, 2006.

name: Event Pianio
desc: A Mura that looks like a keyboard and produces sound when pressed. Though it has existed for a long time, it still contains unresolved mysteries, attracting the interest of scholars.

name: 골든 팬 플룻 YT
desc:
사용법이 간편하고 무게가 가벼워 많은 사람들이 애용하는 황금빛 뮤라. 때문에 리코링 전용 음악 대회도 간간히 열리기도 한다.
이것은 요구르팅 1주년 기념 선물이라고 한다.

name: 브로운 YT
desc:
금관 악기 형상의 뮤라.
이것은 요구르팅 1주년 기념 선물이라고 한다.

name: Clarinet
desc: Hearing the lively sound of this light-brown clarinet naturally lifts one’s spirits. It is a Mura often used in ensemble performances together with the Cymbaline.

name: The DJ
desc: A giant rainbow-colored afro wig with a turntable attached.

name: Tabukai
desc: An earring shaped like a skull.

name: Soprano Pan Flute
desc: A type of pan flute that is lightweight and easy to play, making it popular with many people. It is tuned to produce high notes.

name: Classic Drone
desc: An early model drone. Unlike the modern drones that have been refined over time, it has a distinct charm and a sense of history.

name: Crash Cymbaline
desc: A Mura called the ‘king of percussion’ by cymbaline players. It’s so loud that its use is said to be restricted outside concert halls.

name: Mystic Bongo
desc: A specially crafted shaman bongo passed down through generations. Used only during secret rituals closed to outsiders, it holds great folkloric value.

name: Amati Violin
desc: A master violin crafted by a top-tier artisan. It is said that many of the violins in circulation today were modeled after it.

name: Alto Fluffy
desc: A golden Fluffy that plays beautiful low tones. When you perform a duet with it, the animals of the forest gather around, captivated by the music.

name: Classic Drone WAM
desc:
An instrument belonging to a certain composer said to haunt the music room. The user is imbued with that composer’s power, improving memory. Might come in handy during exams?
(It will become non-tradeable on August 17, 2006, and will be removed on August 24.)

name: Cry Cymbaline
desc:
A cymbaline that produces sound as loud as the cry of the yokai “Konaki-jiji.” The key is to handle it as gently as a baby. It is said that when Konaki-jiji cries, earthquakes occur.
(It will become non-tradeable on August 17, 2006, and will be removed on August 24.)

name: Gashadokuro
desc:
A Mura inhabited by the yokai Gashadokuro. It makes noise night after night, making it quite a nuisance. Gashadokuro is said to be a yokai formed from the grudges of the dead.
(It will become non-tradeable on August 17, 2006, and will be removed on August 24.)

name: Pianio LVB
desc:
An instrument belonging to a certain composer said to haunt the music room. At night, it begins composing and playing on the Pianio keys on its own. If misfortune befalls you as a result, accept it as “fate.”
(It will become non-tradeable on August 17, 2006, and will be removed on August 24.)

name: Tsuina: Demon-Poison Sake
desc:
A powerful sacred sake said to have been the key to defeating the yokai Shuten Doji. Poison to demons, but medicine to humans. The more you drink, the stronger you become—but remember, alcohol is for those 20 and over!
(It will become non-tradeable on August 17, 2006, and will be removed on August 24.)

name: Pan Flute
desc: A Mura that is easy to use and lightweight, making it popular with many people. Dedicated Ricoring music competitions are even occasionally held for it.

name: Soprano Pan Flute
desc: A type of pan flute that is lightweight and easy to play, making it popular with many people. It is tuned to produce high notes.

name: Drone
desc: A Mura shaped like a brass instrument.

name: Classic Drone
desc: An early model drone. Unlike the modern drones that have been refined over time, it has a distinct charm and a sense of history.

name: Clarinet
desc: Hearing the lively sound of this light-brown clarinet naturally lifts one’s spirits. It is a Mura often used in ensemble performances together with the Cymbaline.

name: Crystal Clarinet
desc: A clarinet enhanced with embedded crystal whose molecular structure amplifies the sound, producing a clearer tone.

name: Cymbaline
desc: A Mura that produces an extremely loud and noisy sound. However, when used together with other Muras, it creates a beautiful tone. It is often used during ensemble performances.

name: Crash Cymbaline
desc: A Mura called the ‘king of percussion’ by cymbaline players. It’s so loud that its use is said to be restricted outside concert halls.

name: Shaman Bongo
desc: It has a shape where the outer side is enlarged, with sharp feathers protruding outward.

name: Mystic Bongo
desc: A specially crafted shaman bongo passed down through generations. Used only during secret rituals closed to outsiders, it holds great folkloric value.

name: The DJ
desc: A giant rainbow-colored afro wig with a turntable attached.

name: The DJ SNF
desc: A giant striped afro wig said to shine brightest on Saturday nights.

name: Violino
desc: A Mura capable of producing everything from quiet single tones to intense chords. It can play multiple sounds at once, making it a beginner-level instrument, but difficult to master. Using its skill restores allies within a certain range around the user.

name: Amati Violin
desc: A master violin crafted by a top-tier artisan. It is said that many of the violins in circulation today were modeled after it.

name: Fluffy
desc: A Mura with a long, elongated shape and a slightly silver-colored tone. Its sound is said to be so beautiful that people nearby stop their work and become captivated by the music.

name: Alto Fluffy
desc: A golden Fluffy that plays beautiful low tones. When you perform a duet with it, the animals of the forest gather around, captivated by the music.

name: Tabukai
desc: An earring shaped like a skull.

name: Ethnic Tabukai

name: Tom-Tom Scarf
desc: This winter, this is the must-have! Stand out with the latest fashion!

desc: A wing-shaped Mura said to have been left behind by an angel who returned to the heavens. Intended for upper-grade students.

name: Luciferic Voice
desc: A Mura shaped like black wings, said to have been left behind on earth by an angel who betrayed God out of jealousy toward humans and fell into hell.

name: Pianio

name: Doburock
desc: A Mura whose power everyone acknowledges. However, continued use might lead to alcohol poisoning, so be careful. Remember: alcohol is for those 20 and older!

name: Buzzanova
desc: A Mura whose lively and cheerful movements stand out more than its sound. Each time the wearer shakes their head, its flashy appearance captures everyone’s attention.

name: Ugi Ugi
desc: A Mura said to have been made and used for performances by a once-famous musician. It’s said to represent the musician himself, though it’s unclear whether that refers to his musical sense… or his face.

name: Utanka
desc: A large circular earring with a carved face.

name: Pink Serpent
desc: 귀여운 핑크빛 뱀의 형상을 한 뮤라.

desc: 거대한 날개 장식이 섹시한 느낌을 풍기는, 성인 취향의 뮤라.

name: Drone Anna
desc:
To commemorate Anna taking first place in the 2006 ‘Spring General Election!’
this original Mura was created based on a drone. Its name was also chosen through a public contest, making it a symbol of the friendship between Anna and everyone!

name: Lifeguard
desc: Originally created to fight ancient vampires, this spirit is now mainly used for medical treatment in hospitals. Its red cross mark is distinctive.

name: Ice Mantle
desc: Not only the target of the attack, but the user also feels the cold.

name: Mephisto
desc: A spirit named after the great demon an expedition reportedly encountered while investigating the cause of the EVP phenomenon.

name: Elite Bag
desc: A bag used by elite students. Neatly organized and unmistakably studious.

name: Bookworm Bag
desc: A spirit whose contents are easy to guess from the books sticking out and the tear in the bag. Considered one of the essential items for exemplary Yogurting students.

name: Tsuchinoko Bag
desc:
A bag said to contain a phantom snake. If you accidentally open it, it will leap out and escape with incredible speed, so only fourth-year students or higher can equip it.
It will be removed during the scheduled maintenance on Thursday, May 11, 2006.

name: Daiitoku Lantern
desc:
A lantern said to contain a Yasha that has transcended death, powerful enough to defeat even the King of the Underworld. Its aura is so immense that only fifth-year students or higher can handle it.
It will be removed during the scheduled maintenance on Thursday, May 11, 2006.

name: Red Lantern
desc:
A lantern often seen hanging at oden food stalls. The Yasha sealed inside is drunk, making it weak enough for even first-year students to use.
It will be removed during the scheduled maintenance on Thursday, May 11, 2006.

name: Exo & Birth
desc:
A replica of the Exo Topaz said to have been made by the mysterious artisan brothers Exo and Bath. Surprisingly well-crafted, it can be used by second-year students.
It will be removed during the scheduled maintenance on Thursday, May 11, 2006.

name: Umpire Trunk
desc:
A trunk containing a poor judge who was mistaken for a vampire and sealed inside. Can be used by third-year students.
It will be removed during the scheduled maintenance on Thursday, May 11, 2006.

name: Event Seraphim Horn
desc: A horn-shaped spirit that summons the angel Seraphim. It appears to be bound in chains, leaving one to wonder what exactly is sealed inside.

name: 이온마린 YT
desc:
물의 정령을 소환할 수 있는 스피릿.

name: 빙염의 살라만더 YT
desc:
아담하게 생긴 푸른 가방 가운데에 새겨진 불꽃 문양은 이 가방에서 불러낼 수 있는 스피릿인 살라만더를 가리키는 표식이다.
이것은 요구르팅 1주년 기념 선물이라고 한다.

name: Cobra Bag

name: Undertaker
desc: A coffin-shaped spirit inhabited by skeleton spirits.

desc: A spirit that summons a water spirit. Its moisture contains vitamin C, which is said to help keep the skin firm.

name: Sea Salamander
desc: A salamander whose flame burns completely thanks to a rich oxygen supply, making it glow blue at extremely high temperatures. It apparently can even be submerged in water.

name: Autumn Vespa
desc: A bag filled with tiny tree spirits. Since it was made during the autumn foliage season, the leaves growing from it are beautifully colored.

name: Lucky Turtle Plate

name: Bomber Wing Kai
desc: An improved Bomber Wing that has been successfully made lighter, while keeping the same power as before.

name: Exo Jade
desc: A spirit used to banish evil spirits. It is studded with jade, believed to have protective powers.

name: Aquamarine KP
desc:
A spirit containing the yokai “Kappa,” said to dwell near water and drag passersby into the depths. Toss a cucumber inside and its power might double?
(It will become non-tradeable on August 17, 2006, and will be removed on August 24.)

name: Ao Andon
desc:
A pale blue paper lantern containing the “Kijo,” said to appear at the end of a hundred ghost stories. Sure to be a must-have item for staying cool during the summer!?
(It will become non-tradeable on August 17, 2006, and will be removed on August 24.)

name: Cursed Bomber Wing
desc:
A machine built around the yokai “Kasha,” said to appear at funerals and graveyards to steal corpses, with multiple aero parts docked onto it! Its welcoming flame attack can take down even ghosts in one hit!?
(It will become non-tradeable on August 17, 2006, and will be removed on August 24.)

name: Kesaram Horn
desc:
A horn-shaped spirit that lets you raise the yokai “Kesaran Pasaran.” Be careful—its food, face powder, is sold separately. Raise it well and find happiness.
(It will become non-tradeable on August 17, 2006, and will be removed on August 24.)

name: Ox-Head Demon
desc:
A spirit formed from the head of “Gozuki,” a prison demon with the head of an ox and the body of a human who torments the dead. The constant chewing sounds and foul breath are hard to ignore, but its power is outstanding!
(It will become non-tradeable on August 17, 2006, and will be removed on August 24.)
